title: Local devices
description: Connect a local companion to use repositories and resources approved on your computer.
actionFailed: The operation failed. Refresh the device and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
enrollmentTitle: Complete the connection on your computer
tokenHint: Run the command on your computer and paste this token into its standard input when requested. The token is shown only here, expires at {{expires}}, and is not a device credential.
confirmHint: After local approval, refresh this list, review the device and its permissions, then confirm here. Start the companion only after confirmation.
expired: This pairing has expired. Start a new connection.
confirmDescription: Allow {{label}} to serve the repositories and limits shown below for your account.
revokeDescription: Disconnect {{label}} and refuse further requests using its current device credential. The device's local data is not deleted.
limits: {{cpu}} CPU · {{memory}} GiB memory · {{storage}} GiB storage · up to {{count}} sandboxes
resourcesDescription: Create and manage GitHub Codespaces or approved local sandboxes through the same resource controls.
createHint: You hold {{held}} of {{max}} resources under this provider's Moira limits. Local capacity and its approval lease are controlled on the device.
connectionRequired: Connect and confirm a local device with approved repositories above.
unavailable: Local work is unavailable. Check the device's enabled state, approval lease and connection, then refresh.
localDisclosure: Local execution uses the applied repositories, limits and finite lease approved by your companion. Web changes stay pending until applied. Revoking access here does not delete local files.

editor.title: Settings for {{label}}
editor.optIn: Update the local companion, then run npm run local -- web-control --confirm --max-lease-hours 168 on this computer to approve web control within your local ceilings. Use the same --state as your setup. Existing grants and files are preserved.
editor.requestHint: Saving requests a change within the computer's approved ceiling. The effective permissions above change only after the companion applies it. Offline computers keep the request pending.
editor.futureProfile: CPU and RAM defaults apply to new environments. Existing environments retain their admitted machine profile; a settings request does not live-resize them.
editor.authorHint: Leave both fields empty to use your verified GitHub identity when available. Your computer's Git configuration is not copied.

states.pending: Requested revision {{requested}}; applied revision {{applied}}. Waiting for the computer.
states.rejected: Revision {{requested}} was rejected; revision {{applied}} remains applied.

editor.invalid: Check the values, repository names and Git identity. Limits must fit the locally approved ceiling and the work lease must be finite, no more than seven days.
editor.label: Computer name
editor.leaseCeiling: Locally approved maximum: {{hours}} hours. This does not renew automatically.
